data.name: S_Location_D
data.value: Settings, rosters, history, proofs, and images all live in this directory

data.name: S_CurrentRoot_D
data.value: The data directory in use; a change takes effect after a migration or restart

data.name: S_Source_D
data.value: Whether this directory came from a launch option, an environment variable, the stored anchor, or an older default location

data.name: S_AnchorPath_D
data.value: Records the selected data directory; it lives outside the data directory, so updating the app never overwrites it

data.name: S_Change_D
data.value: Switching locations copies the existing data to the new directory, verifies it, writes the anchor, and restarts the app; the old directory is renamed and kept until you delete it yourself

data.name: S_Mode_D
data.value: The portable package directory follows the package; the standard location keeps data out of the program directory; a custom directory is whatever you choose

data.name: S_Target_D
data.value: The target must be empty or not exist yet, and must not be inside the application directory

data.name: S_OtherRoots_D
data.value: These directories also hold data but are not in use; they are never migrated or deleted automatically, so review and clean them up yourself

data.name: M_LegacyNotice
data.value: The data still lives in the program directory. An app update replaces that directory, so migrating to the system standard location is recommended.

data.name: M_NoOtherRoots
data.value: No other data directories were found.

data.name: M_DesktopOnly
data.value: On mobile the data directory is fixed by the system and cannot be changed.

data.name: M_RestartContent
M_Err_SourceMissing
data.value: The current data directory does not exist, so it cannot be migrated.

data.name: M_Err_TargetInvalid
data.value: The target directory is invalid; choose another location.

data.name: M_Err_SameRoot
data.value: The target directory is the current data directory.

data.name: M_Err_Nested
data.value: The target directory must not contain the current data directory or be inside it.

data.name: M_Err_InsideApp
data.value: The target directory must not be inside the application directory, or an update would lose the data.

data.name: M_Err_NotEmpty
data.value: The target directory must be empty or not exist yet.

data.name: M_Err_NotWritable
data.value: The target directory is not writable; check permissions or choose another location.

data.name: M_Err_Journal
data.value: The migration journal could not be written; check permissions on the application data directory.

data.name: M_RootUnavailable
data.value: The current data directory is unavailable; fix the startup problem first.
